evidence.quote: Huhnseal AB is a Swedish company that develops and manufactures mechanical seals for the modern process industry. At the site in Landskrona, sealing solutions are designed, tested and manufactured for the global market. || Visiting and delivery address: Huhnseal AB Jarvgatan 1 Landskrona Sweden || Our customers are found in a wide range of businesses such as pulp & paper, food & beverage, pharmaceutical, mining, general process and in the offshore industry.
